name: Oro Valley
seo_title: Oro Valley Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Oro Valley, Arizona for 2026: 4 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Oro Valley celebrates Christmas with a two-day Festival of the Arts and a 35-foot holiday tree at the Marketplace, a snowy town event at the Community and Recreation Center and a scavenger hunt at historic Steam Pump Ranch.
celebrates: The Town of Oro Valley anchors the season with the Festival of the Arts and Holiday Tree Lighting at the Oro Valley Marketplace, where more than 150 artists and exhibitors, over 500 student and community performers, children's activities and a visit from Santa fill a winter wonderland, according to the town. Santa's Workshop tent and a Winter Wonderland Post Office for letters to the North Pole are part of the festival. The town's Parks and Recreation team adds SnOV, with games, crafts and actual snow, and Oro Valley Church of the Nazarene lights three 30-foot trees with hayrides and a live nativity.
lastyear: The 14th annual Oro Valley Holiday Festival of the Arts and Tree Lighting ran December 6 and 7, 2025, with free admission and more than 150 artists and exhibitors, according to a Visit Tucson post. A festival video from 2025 shows the Golden Glow Tree Lighting, with the 35-foot tree sparkling with handcrafted ornaments and a snowfall finale. The festival is set to return as the 15th annual event in 2026, according to the Town of Oro Valley's post.
facts: Steam Pump Ranch, where Oro Valley's holiday scavenger hunt takes place, goes back to 1874 and now covers 16 acres on the National Register of Historic Places, according to the Town of Oro Valley, which bought it in 2008. The Town finished restoring the Pusch House, now a museum, in 2010, the Oro Valley Historical Society says. The Festival of the Arts also lists TubaChristmas at 2 pm on its Saturday, according to Explore Oro Valley.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Oro Valley itself. The closest rail history is in Tucson. The Tucson Amtrak station at 400 N Toole Avenue serves the Sunset Limited and Texas Eagle, according to Amtrak, and the Southern Arizona Transportation Museum in the old depot is free, its own site says. The Old Pueblo Trolley runs a free transit museum on South 4th Avenue. Trail Dust Town runs a Christmas Express train ride on Festive Fridays, listed on the Tucson page.

faq: How does Oro Valley celebrate Christmas?

The town holds a two-day Festival of the Arts with a 35-foot holiday tree at the Oro Valley Marketplace, plus SnOV at the Community and Recreation Center. Oro Valley Church of the Nazarene lights three 30-foot trees with hayrides and a live nativity, and the Historical Society runs a holiday scavenger hunt at Steam Pump Ranch.
Is there a free Christmas event in Oro Valley?

Yes. The town lists the Festival of the Arts and Holiday Tree Lighting as free, the town's Facebook post says SnOV admission is completely free, and Oro Valley Church of the Nazarene calls its tree lighting free. Each listing on this page has the host's details.
Where can kids meet Santa in Oro Valley?

The town lists a special visit from Santa at the Festival of the Arts, SnOV includes a visit from Santa, and the church tree lighting lists pictures with Santa. Check each listing on this page for dates and times.
Is there a train ride in Oro Valley?

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Oro Valley for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (the Oro Valley Festival of the Arts and Holiday Tree Lighting) through December 19 (the last Desert Clues and Holiday Treasure hunt at Steam Pump Ranch), with the Christmas Tree Lighting and Live Nativity at Oro Valley Church of the Nazarene (December 5) and SnOV (December 17) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Oro Valley

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Oro Valley
  • 3 free events: the Oro Valley Festival of the Arts and Holiday Tree Lighting, the Christmas Tree Lighting and Live Nativity at Oro Valley Church of the Nazarene and SnOV
  • Meet Santa: the Festival of the Arts, the church tree lighting and SnOV all list a Santa visit
  • Parades and tree lightings: the 35-foot holiday tree at the Festival of the Arts (December 5) and three 30-foot trees at the church (December 5)
